title: CorpID Sync Hotfixes & Capacity Management
changes: Fixed CorporateIdentifierSync issues related to the tenant limit on Corporate Identifiers (CorpIDs).
Delete function now returns Success, NotFound, or Error instead of relying solely on REST status codes.
Add function now checks whether a CorpID is already present and treats that as success instead of failing.
Added a CorpID counter and capacity manager to track how many CorpIDs are in use across the system.
Added a singleton lock to prevent multiple instances of the same function from running at once.
Added a function to audit CorpID counts against device status and Graph to catch discrepancies.
Split the logic that migrates devices to syncing on tag enablement from the logic that resyncs existing CorpIDs.
Added a failed status to stop continuous retries on devices that repeatedly fail to sync.
Added the SeedCorpIDCounter WebJob for initializing the CorpID counter during deployment.
Fixed duplicate serial number entries for non-Windows devices pointing at the same CorpID.
Fixed a bug where preferred hostname regex validation wasn't executing in all cases.
Updated dependency libraries to address recently identified vulnerabilities.

title: Security Fix - Device Tag Access
changes: Fixed a security vulnerability on the Devices screen that returned devices to users outside of the tags they have access to.

title: Duplicate Hostname Prevention
changes: Added logic to prevent users from re-using the same preferred hostname across multiple devices.

title: Logging & Telemetry Improvements
changes: Increased the function timeout to 4 hours to address lost logs in production.
Migrated to the Application Insights SDK and disabled log filtering.
Ensured Adaptive Sampling is disabled so all telemetry is captured.

title: Tag Search & Hostname Requirements
changes: Added Tag Search.
Replaced the system-wide Preferred Hostname requirement with tag-specific requirements.
Added a tag-specific device naming enablement flag and optional tag-specific regex validation for the Preferred Hostname field.

title: Intune Autopilot 2.0 Support
changes: Added syncing of devices with the Intune Corporate Identifiers list in preparation for Intune Autopilot 2.0.
Added a new backend function app responsible for syncing.
Added a new OS field to support future use of MacOS, iOS, and Android devices.
Added tag-level and application-level settings to enable or disable syncing.
Added device naming on enrollment in support of Intune Autopilot 2.0, including a new required Preferred Hostname field.
Added a WebJob to set the Preferred Hostname field of already-enrolled devices to their current device name.
Improved the devices screen and search capabilities.
Updated dependency libraries for security and hygiene.
